items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: At one time I used to pal around with them. I'd go to the News or something for dinner and all that.

ctx.x: The name of that room was the Composer Room. That was the most beautiful room and I loved it. But the craziest thing happened. We had two managers there and the crowds were tremendous. They just fought, fought, fought so much even with the big crowds there until finally people just stopped going, you know. But it was terrific. Now that was the first club date that I had. I worked there and then repeated a couple of times and then I went in again. Dizzy called and Melba and all the musicians were trying to get me…
